meta_desc: Zviverengi zvemahara zvekuvaka nezveDIY: kutsvedza kwedenga, kongiri, pendi, mataira nemasitepisi. Mhinduro pakarepo, hapana kushambadza, inoshanda isina indaneti.
og_desc: Zviverengi zvedenga, kongiri, pendi, mataira nemasitepisi. Mahara, pakarepo, hapana kushambadza.
lede: Zviverengi zvishanu zvinokurumidza zvebasa chairo. Hapana kushambadza, hapana kuteverwa, hapana kunyoresa. Mhinduro imwe neimwe inoratidza kuverenga kwayo, uye zvese zvinoramba zvichishanda pasina indaneti kana zvangovhurwa.
card_roof: Kukwira nekureba kwakatwasuka kuva madhigirii, pesenti uye X:12, pamwe neyekuwanza yekutsvedza yenzvimbo yedenga.
card_concrete: Huwandu hwekongiri nenhamba chaiyo yemabhegi, pamwe nechikamu chekurasika.
card_paint: Pendi yakawanda sei yemba yako, kubvisa madhoo nemawindo, zvichienderana nenhamba yemacoat.
card_tile: Mataira nemabhokisi kubva munzvimbo nehukuru hwetaira, pamwe nemukaha wegrout nekurasika pakucheka.
card_stair: Nhanho nematanho kubva pakureba kwese, zvakaongororwa nemiganhu yemutemo uye mutemo wekugadzikana.
why_text: Mawebhusaiti mazhinji ekuverenga anovanza fomura iri nyore pasi pekushambadza, mapopup nemadziro etsamba dzenhau. Maturusi mashanu aya anoita zvakasiyana: chiverengi chiri pamusoro, fomura inonyorwa pasi pemhinduro, uye peji rinovhurika muchikamu chesekondi. Kana turusi rikuponesa rwendo rusina basa kuchitoro, pane bhatani rekupa rubatsiro mushure memhinduro yako. Ndiwo muenzaniso wese webhizimisi.
